items.title: Everton sign Johnson from Palace in transfer swap for McNeil
items.description: Everton have signed winger Brennan Johnson from Crystal Palace in a transfer swap deal that sees Dwight McNeil move to Selhurst Park.

items.title: Meet Osasuna's new coach who started in Real Madrid's academy
items.description: As a player, Luis Miguel Ramis made his debut in LaLiga with Real Madrid and went on to win the competition with Deportivo La Coruna. Now 56 years old, the route back to Spain’s top division has taken him rather longer as a coach. But he has made it.

items.title: Scottish striker Ure makes £5.5m Sevilla move
items.description: Sevilla announce £5.5m move, rising to potential £7.6m, for former Scotland youth international striker Robbie Ure to join from Swedish club IK Sirius.
